RWA.note: Document does not state that the National Bank of Rwanda licenses providers, runs a switch or is on PAPSS; it speaks only of a planned passporting framework.
Document states nothing on consumer protection.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.
Document gives no account-ownership survey figure.

facts.fact: The National Bank of Rwanda and the Central Bank of Kenya signed an MoU on 11 March 2026 committing to develop a licence passporting framework for payment service providers, anchored on the EAC Cross-Border Payment System Masterplan.

RWA.note: Document names licensed PSPs in Rwanda only in passing and states no mobile money or retail service in service.
Document states nothing on revenue collection.
